title: Stop a handler chain
summary: Gin: Stop a handler chain. Replace the blocking first handler with c.Next and compare.
introduction: AbortWithStatusJSON stops later handlers in the chain. GET /closed receives this practice block message.
learningObjectives: Stop a handler chain with Gin
Replace the blocking first handler with c.Next and compare

blocks.text: Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Stop a handler chain

blocks.text: AbortWithStatusJSON writes the error and stops later handlers. The second handler is not called.
Replace the blocking first handler with c.Next and compare.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Abort stops later handlers but does not return from the current Go function.
